reference_metadata.conditioning: past/current 16-transition mean of state and executed action; normal-fit scaling
reference_metadata.fit_window_sampling: disjoint full windows; no episode-reset history clearing
reference_metadata.covariance_estimator: normal-block-selected mixture of regularized global and local OAS covariance

weight_selection.objective: mean Gaussian negative log likelihood excluding additive constant

limitations: Reused development trajectories from one source training seed; not independent confirmation.
Blocked normal predictive likelihood is not an OOD detection objective or a coverage guarantee.
This fixed-beta readout replay does not establish adaptive RL returns.
